title: RIETE score pour risque de hémorragie dans embolie pulmonaire traitement
formula:
Le score RIETE est calculé en additionnant les points retenus pour chaque variable :

| Facteur de risque | Valeur en points |
| --- | --- |
| Saignement majeur récent | 2 |
| Cr >1.2 mg/dL | 1.5 |
| Anémie | 1.5 |
| Cancer | 1 |
| EP cliniquement manifeste | 1 |
| Âge >75 | 1 |

how_to_use.why:
- Predicts major bleeding risk during the first 3 months of anticoagulation for DVT or PE, with strongest performance for fatal bleeding; results may help guide therapy and monitoring decisions.
- Named by the[2019 European Society of Cardiology/European Respiratory Society PE guidelines](https://academic.oup.com/eurheartj/article/41/4/543/5556136)as one of several validated bleeding-risk scores.
how_to_use.when: À utiliser chez les patients nouvellement diagnostiqués avec une thrombose veineuse profonde aiguë (DVT) ou une embolie pulmonaire (PE) au moment de l’initiation de l’anticoagulation.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Developed from the RIETE registry to estimate the risk of major bleeding during anticoagulation for acute DVT or PE.
- The derivation cohort included patients with symptomatic, objectively confirmed acute venous thromboembolism (VTE):

 - DVT diagnosed by compression ultrasonography or venography.
 - PE diagnosed by pulmonary angiography, lung scintigraphy, or helical CT.
- Major bleeding in the derivation study was defined as overt bleeding plus ≥1 of the following:

 - Requirement for transfusion of ≥2 units of blood.
 - Retroperitoneal, spinal, or intracranial bleeding.
 - Fatal bleeding.
- Anemia was included as a predictor in the derivation study, though a specific hemoglobin threshold was not clearly defined in the original publication; subsequent analyses commonly defined anemia as hemoglobin <13 g/dL in men and <12 g/dL in women.
- The derivation and validation cohorts were both drawn from the same registry population, limiting true external validation of the original model.
- External validation studies have demonstrated modest overall discrimination, with reported c-statistics generally ranging from approximately 0.55-0.70.
- Predictive performance appears strongest for:

 - Fatal bleeding.
 - Early extracranial bleeding events during the initial treatment period.
- Performance is less reliable for:

 - Intracranial hemorrhage.
 - Late bleeding events (>90 days after anticoagulation initiation).
- Predictive discrimination appears reduced in patients with active malignancy, with reported c-statistics falling to approximately 0.50-0.61 in some cohorts.
- The derivation population was treated predominantly with low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) and vitamin K antagonists (<5% of patients received DOAC therapy); use caution when extrapolating performance to modern DOAC monotherapy populations.
- Not intended for:

 - Pediatric patients.
 - Pregnancy or postpartum-associated VTE.
 - Unusual-site thrombosis (e.g., cerebral venous sinus thrombosis, splanchnic vein thrombosis).
 - Critically ill ICU populations.
- Risk assessment is static and reflects the patient only at anticoagulation initiation; it does not dynamically account for interval clinical changes such as:

 - New renal or hepatic dysfunction.
 - Initiation of antiplatelet therapy.

next_steps.advice:
- Utiliser comme complément au jugement clinique plutôt que comme outil décisionnel autonome.
- Réévaluer régulièrement le risque hémorragique pendant le traitement, car le modèle ne prend en compte que le risque initial et ne tient pas compte des modifications cliniques intercurrentes.
- La performance prédictive diminue lorsqu'il est appliqué au-delà des 3 premiers mois d'anticoagulation.
- Quelle que soit la stratégie de prise en charge choisie, le consentement éclairé reste essentiel.
next_steps.critical_actions: Les risques et les bénéfices de l’anticoagulation doivent être soigneusement pesés chez TOUS les patients avant l’instauration du traitement.
next_steps.management:
- **Risque faible :** L'initiation d'une anticoagulation avec une surveillance standard est généralement raisonnable.
- **Risque intermédiaire :** Évaluer attentivement les risques et les bénéfices de l'anticoagulation avant d'initier le traitement.
- **Risque élevé :** Envisager des stratégies de prise en charge alternatives et une surveillance plus rapprochée chez les patients à haut risque hémorragique.

more_info:
Interpretation:

| RIETE Score | Risk of Major Bleeding |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Low |
| 1 – 4 | Intermediate |
| >4 | High |
medium_description: Déterminer le risque d’hémorragie majeure pendant un traitement anticoagulant.
